subject: fix(acl): prevent NULL pointer dereference on malformed selector in ACL file (#4214)
reason: The fix (src/acl.c:3244) adds a missing `sdsfreesplitres(argv, argc); continue;` so that when ACLMergeSelectorArguments returns NULL on a user line with an unmatched parenthesis in a selector, the loader stops instead of falling through to `for (j=0; j<merged_argc; j++) acl_args[j]=...` with merged_argc uninitialized and acl_args NULL (a NULL-pointer dereference / SIGSEGV). It is a genuine crash fix, but no installed experiment nor one I can write reaches it as a scored finding, for reasons intrinsic to the change.
